# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 21 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 21:3 — gave up his spirit vs. breathed his last

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "gave up his spirit to God" | Literal tradidit spiritum suum |
| LOGOS | "gave up his spirit to God" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "gave up his spirit to God" | Same — all agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three agree. The phrase 'gave up his spirit to God' echoes standard biblical death language. No divergence.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.
